claim: NCBI Gene/RefSeq describes CD74 as an MHC class II-associated chaperone involved in antigen presentation and as a cell-surface receptor for macrophage migration inhibitory factor.
future_grounding_route: Use only as molecular-background context; project claims about coupled APC architecture require rerunnable module and cell-state data.
project_use: External molecular context explaining why CD74 can sit at the intersection of HLA-II antigen-presentation biology and MIF receptor biology.
relationship_note: This converges on molecular plausibility of the coupling but is not MS-specific and is not evidence for the project's axis structure.

source.citation: NCBI Gene record 972, CD74 molecule, Homo sapiens.
